layout_decisions: Cloud Run and Cloud SQL follow GCP project and regional scopes; Cloud SQL remains outside the customer VPC boundary while using private IP through Private Services Access.
Cloud Run is drawn outside the VPC and connected through a dedicated Direct VPC egress subnet.
PITR recovery is a new Cloud SQL instance; original primary remains intact during validation.
Application and recovery revisions are stacked in one service; recovery receives no traffic until the data gate passes.
Database and object-recovery tasks are stacked vertically as parallel paths that converge at one validation gate.
Connectors use orthogonal routes and avoid unrelated resource frames.
